claims.claim: A_F is nonempty for every real L1 boundary datum via the slit Poisson construction.
W_F is unbounded above at each nonzero interior point for every real L1 F.
For mean F≤0, P[F] uniquely maximizes each point evaluation in A_F.
For positive constant c, supremum in A_c is (4c/pi) atan(sqrt(abs(z0))).
A_c is nonconvex, not max-closed; no finite set of sampled radii certifies its continuum constraint.
General positive-mean nonconstant-data sharp extremal problem.

scope: A_F requires finite interior-continuous subharmonic functions, Poisson majorization, a.e. radial trace F, and all-radius circle-minimum condition. These are explicit chosen assumptions, not claimed equivalent to the printed wording.
